connector.name: Cognitive Ai Memory
connector.registryDescription: Ebbinghaus-based persistent memory for Claude. Memories decay with time, strengthen on recall.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image cognitive-ai-memory:1.0.2. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sachitrafa account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string with pgvector. Example: postgresql://localhost:5432/yourmemory

env.name: OLLAMA_URL
env.description: Ollama server URL for local embeddings (nomic-embed-text) and classification (llama3.2:3b). Default: http://localhost:11434

env.name: EXTRACT_MODEL
env.description: Ollama model used for fact/assumption classification. Default: llama3.2:3b
